blocks.text: Zscaler Internet & SaaS (ZIA) is a cloud-native Security Service Edge (SSE) platform that gives users secure, fast, and reliable access to the internet and SaaS applications. Part of the Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange (ZTE), Internet & SaaS is designed to replace legacy, hardware-centric security point solutions with a scalable, AI-powered security architecture. Rather than route traffic to a centralized data center, Internet & SaaS delivers security directly at the edge, enforcing policy-based security protocols to ensure a consistent user experience regardless of location, whether in a branch office, at home, or traveling.

Internet & SaaS acts as an inline, secure gateway between users, workloads, and the internet. When a user or workload requests access to an external resource, the traffic is routed to the nearest Public Service Edge for Internet & SaaS.
The platform then performs the following actions:

blocks.item: Full SSL/TLS Inspection: Internet & SaaS decrypts and inspects encrypted web and related (e.g., FTP) traffic at scale, ensuring that threats hidden within encrypted streams are detected without degrading performance.
Policy Enforcement: Every request is checked against your organization’s granular security and data protection policies.
Identity-Based Access: Access is granted based on the identity of the user, the health of the device, and the context of the request, rather than the user's network location.

Cyberthreat Protection: Traffic is analyzed in real time by multiple security engines, including AI-powered sandboxing, antivirus, and advanced threat protection (ATP). After the traffic is verified as "clean" and compliant with policy, it is forwarded directly to its destination.

blocks.text: Internet & SaaS offers several advantages over traditional security appliances and VPN-based architectures:

blocks.item: Superior User Experience: By eliminating the need for routing traffic to a central location, Internet & SaaS reduces latency and provides faster access to company-critical cloud applications, like Microsoft 365 and Salesforce.
Reduced Attack Surface: Internet & SaaS makes your network invisible to the internet, preventing discovery and stopping lateral movement within it.
Simplified Management: As a 100% cloud-delivered service, Internet & SaaS eliminates the need to buy, deploy, and manage hardware appliances, like firewalls and web gateways.
Global Scalability: The Zscaler ZTE is the world’s largest security cloud, with over 150 data centers globally, providing high availability and localized peering.
Unified Data Protection: Internet & SaaS provides consistent Data Loss Prevention (DLP) and SaaS Security capabilities across all users and locations.

blocks.text: Internet & SaaS provides a comprehensive suite of security and compliance tools:

blocks.item: Cloud Secure Web Gateway (SWG): Provides URL filtering, reputation-based blocking, and advanced web security.
Firewall: A full-featured, user- and application-aware firewall with DNS security and Intrusion Prevention Systems (IPS) that protects all ports and protocols.
SaaS Security: Secures data at rest and in transit within SaaS applications, preventing unauthorized data sharing.
DLP: Identifies and protects sensitive data (e.g., PII, PCI, intellectual property) across all internet and SaaS traffic.
AI-Powered Sandboxing: Instantly detects and blocks patient 0 attacks by analyzing suspicious files in a virtual environment.
Zero Trust Browser: Executes active web content in a remote, isolated container to prevent malware from reaching the user's device.

blocks.text: Organizations can easily connect their traffic to Internet & SaaS using several methods:

blocks.item: Zscaler Client Connector: A lightweight app installed on user devices that automatically tunnels traffic to the nearest Zscaler node.
Cloud Tunnels: Secure GRE or IPSec tunnels from branch office routers or SD-WAN gateways.
Proxy Auto-Configuration (PAC) Files: Lightweight files that instruct browsers to route traffic to the Zscaler service.
